reproduction.error: Conference startup failed: Failed to fetch
reproduction.diagnostic: Fetch API cannot load file:///.../src/fonts/seguiemj.ttf. URL scheme "file" is not supported.

cause: The modular manifest used fetch() to read font files from disk; browsers reject file-scheme fetch before conference fonts are registered or polling starts.

fix.directFile: Load the generated font bytes using a classic script, then retain the existing acquisition and rendering pipeline.
fix.http: Continue fetching individual font files; no extra font-pack request.
fix.portable: Font data remains embedded; no companion files needed.
fix.diagnostics: Missing local font pack gives rebuild/portable instructions; HTTP failures identify the bundled font.

newChecks: Direct-file modular startup without local font fetches
Missing local font pack gives actionable instructions
